newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israeli man abducted in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Israeli man abducted in Cairo.

text.p: Unidentified men have abducted an Israeli man in northeastern Cairo and the Israeli embassy said on Monday it wanted to discuss the case with Egyptian Interior Minister Hassan el-Alfi.

Israeli charge d'affaires Jacob Gil told Reuters that the Israeli, Azam Azam, had been working at a Cairo textile factory and was on his way back to the Baron Hotel in the suburb of Medinet Nasr last Wednesday when he was abducted.
"His father says people from security took him away. We checked this at a very high level and they know nothing about it. They have no reason not to tell us the truth," he added.
"I have asked to meet the interior minister," he added. The minister has not yet given him an appointment, he said.
Gil said Azam, who is in his late 30s, had been working at the factory for a short time but he did not know in what capacity or have any other details of the textile factory.
The interior ministry's information department said they had no information on the case.
